examples.arabic: كان سامي، الخباز القديم، بيقضي نهاره بوسط الردم بمدينة حلب وهو عم يحاول يرجع الحياة لمخبزه الصغير يلي تهدم نصه.
examples.english: Sami, the old baker, was spending his day in the middle of the rubble in Aleppo city, trying to bring life back to his small bakery, half of which was destroyed.
examples.transliteration: Kan Sami, al-khabbaz al-qadim, biyaqdi naharo bi-wasat al-radm bi-madinat Halab wa-huwa am yuhawil yarajji al-hayat li-makhbazo al-saghir yalli thaddam nusso.
examples.storyTitle: A Loaf of Hope Amidst the Rubble

examples.arabic: هو سأل الخباز أبو فادي، مرحبا، كيفك، هدول بكفوا لمنقوشة زعتر؟
examples.english: He asked the baker Abu Fadi, hello, how are you, are these enough for a thyme man'oushe?
examples.transliteration: Huwwe saal el khabbaz Abu Fadi, marhaba, kifak, hadol bikaffu la manoushet zaatar?

examples.arabic: سأل أبو شادي، الخباز الختيار: "مرحبا، كيفك؟ بدي منقوشة زعتر هلق لو سمحت، بقديش؟"
examples.english: He asked Abu Shadi, the old baker: "Hello, how are you? I want a zaatar manakish now please, how much is it?"
examples.transliteration: sa'al abu shadi, el-khabbaz el-khetyar: "marhaba, kifak? biddi manqoushet zaatar hallaq law samaht, biqaddesh?"

examples.arabic: "يلا، بدي أي منقوشة بسرعة!" حكى طارق، طالب جامعة مستعجل عمرو تنين وعشرين سنة، للخباز بشارع الحمرا.
examples.english: "Yalla, I want any man'ouche quickly!" said Tariq, an impatient university student who is twenty-two years old, to the baker on Hamra Street.
examples.transliteration: "Yalla, biddi ay man'oucheh bisur'ah!" haka Tariq, talib jami'ah musta'jel 'umro tnein wa 'ishrin sanah, lil-khabbaz bishari' al-Hamra.
